verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that external agents connect to through its API, MCP server, CLI, SDKs and framework integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product, such as a console copilot, that a user can hand tasks to. The natural-language capabilities cited, such as the Google ADK and LangChain integrations, belong to the user's own agents and do not count as a native assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
